disclosure: Evidence basis: Official first-party documentation. This page describes the supplier’s own published claims and does not independently verify performance, reliability, yield or comparative advantage.

entries.exactLocator: Overview and One platform, multiple tools sections
entries.establishes: That Axcelis publishes a single ion-implantation platform, Purion, in high-current, mid-current, medium-energy and high-energy variants sharing a common architecture with three beamline technologies, and that Axcelis states a throughput figure of up to 500 wafers per hour for it.
entries.doesNotEstablish: The throughput figure is the company's own published number, not a measured or independently verified one. The page carries no yield, reliability or availability data, no comparison with any other supplier, and no publication date, so it cannot establish current product availability or that any figure was achieved in production.

entries.establishes: That DISCO publishes equipment lines for dicing, laser dicing, grinding, polishing, wafer mounting, inspection, die separation, surface planing and waterjet cutting, organised around cutting, grinding and polishing processes.
entries.doesNotEstablish: The page carries no throughput, yield or reliability figures, no comparison with any other supplier, and no publication date. It establishes what DISCO lists, not how any machine performs or whether any line is currently available.

entries.publishedOrVersion: undated page; copyright notice reads 1995 to 2026
entries.establishes: That Advantest publishes four named automatic test system families and states which device classes each is intended to test, including the named memory standards for the T5801.
entries.doesNotEstablish: The page carries no measured throughput, no yield or reliability data and no comparison with any other supplier. It is undated, so it cannot establish current availability. Its promotional wording about precision and leadership is not a documented capability and is excluded here.

entries.establishes: That Lam Research publishes equipment and solution categories spanning deposition, etch, strip and clean, mass metrology and panel processing, and names cryogenic etching and metallization among them.
entries.doesNotEstablish: The inspected page is a navigation hub. It carries no process parameters, no performance or yield data and no comparison with any other supplier, and it is undated, so it cannot establish current product availability and says nothing about how any tool performs.

entries.establishes: That Synopsys publishes five IP categories and the specific protocols and block types it offers under each, including the named interface protocols and the named foundation memory and library types.
entries.doesNotEstablish: The page carries no benchmark, no silicon results, no yield or reliability data and no third-party validation. It is undated, so it cannot establish current product availability, and its claims about portfolio breadth and area-power-performance are promotional rather than documented capability.

entries.establishes: That Dow publishes named chemical product families under the ELECPURE portfolio and maps each class onto specific semiconductor, display and printed circuit board process steps, including which classes it supplies for CMP slurry, photoresist coating, etching and stripping.
entries.doesNotEstablish: A product selection guide. It gives no purity specification, no measured process result, no yield or reliability data and no comparison with any other supplier. It carries no publication date, so it cannot establish current product availability.

entries.publishedOrVersion: undated page; copyright notice reads 2010 to 2026
entries.establishes: That TSMC publishes a logic node portfolio spanning A12 through 0.18 micrometre, and describes A12 as combining a second-generation backside power rail with a nanosheet transistor.
entries.doesNotEstablish: The page gives no yield, no defect density and no independently verified performance figure. It is undated, so it cannot establish current availability of any node.
